summary: Christian County, KY tower, 60 ft, erection under way June 1948 for the Kentucky Division of Forestry. No later history or site status found.

events.note: Erection of the tower was under way on June 5, 1948; the clipping gives no completion date

evidence.supports: A 60-foot fire lookout tower was being erected about five and a half miles east of Crofton, announced by District Forester E.R. Wagoner
evidence.quote: Erection of a 60-foot fire lookout tower five and a half miles east of Crofton was under way today, District Forester E.R. Wagoner announced.

evidence.supports: The concrete base was in place and the steel beams were going up
evidence.quote: The concrete foundation has been poured and the raising of the steel beams is under way.

evidence.supports: The Kentucky Division of Forestry ran the work; Walter Green was supervising it in the county
evidence.quote: Walter Green, superintendent of Maintenance and Construction of the Kentucky Division of Forestry, is in the county to supervise the work on the new tower

evidence.supports: The tower was being placed on one of the highest points in the county, giving the observer a wide range
evidence.quote: which is being placed on one of the highest points in the county--thus giving the observer a wide range.

evidence.supports: This was the second tower in Christian County; observers would watch 85 per cent of the district's forest land
evidence.quote: With the completion of the second tower in Christian County, observers will be able to keep watch over 85 per cent of the forest land in the district.

evidence.supports: The clipping mentions a No. 2 tower in the county, placed in the Pennyrile Park area; it does not say whether that is this tower
evidence.quote: The No. 2 tower in this county is located in the Pennyrile Park area.

evidence.supports: The National Historic Lookout Register lists 17 Kentucky lookouts; Crofton is not among them
evidence.quote: There are 17 lookouts registered in Kentucky.

corrections.why: The clipping's body text says 'Christian County'. 'Christain' is a typo in the site's heading, copied into the record.
Same typo as the county field, in the brief's local unit.

sources.title: Crofton
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (eastern US), quoting the Kentucky New Era

notes_for_editor: The only source on this tower is a 1948 clipping, which gives the 60-ft height, the June 1948 erection and the agency. No completion date, staffing, fate or present status found. The clipping's 'No. 2 tower ... Pennyrile Park' sentence is ambiguous and is not resolved. The record point (37.0636, -87.3792) is about 9.6 km east of Wikipedia's Crofton centre (37.04778, -87.48528), roughly consistent with 'five and a half miles east'; not checked on a map. A WebSearch snippet mentioned an antenna-structure record for a roughly 295 ft communications tower in Crofton; that is not a lookout and was not read, so it is a lead only. The story is about 176 words.
